neighbours.label: A subject pronoun right after a fronted 'what' clause and comma ('What you sow, you reap'), or after a fronted object in parallel clauses; the same words in normal order stay quiet. Second round: bare fronted objects scored low in round one
fire: What he owes, he will repay.
What you sow, you reap in time.
What little food they had, they shared with us.
What she lacked in height, she made up in speed.
His first play I loved; his last I hated.
quiet: He will repay what he owes.
You reap in time what you sow.
They shared what little food they had with us.
She made up in speed what she lacked in height.
I loved his first play and hated his last.
